title: fix: restore MiniMax Turbo rates for September 30, 2026
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- **Target: deploy before fal’s promotion ends September 30, 2026.** Exact cutoff time/timezone is unconfirmed. #15550 is merged; this PR now contains only the rate restoration and matching expectations.
- Update MiniMax H3 Max Turbo cost and customer price together to published post-promotion rates: 480p $0.025/s, 768p $0.04/s, 1080p $0.08/s. Keep `priceMultiplier: 1`.
- Maintainer accepts switching a few hours early with temporary customer overpayment. Merge manually, then promote to production and complete the Cloudflare deployment before fal switches. No automatic activation or auto-merge.
- Incorporate #15550’s review fixes. Validation: 237 focused tests pass on both branches; shared-code Gen/Enter type checks pass. Six authenticated promo-rate cases cover both routes at all resolutions and reconcile with fal: five seconds costs $0.0625/$0.10/$0.20. Each proves disconnect/rejoin, identical cache retrieval, and one upstream job/debit/billed event. A fresh restore-branch smoke verifies configured cost=price=0.125 for 480p/5s.
- Actual future-charge verification remains deferred with approval to merge beforehand. Reconcile after the promotion; configured cost may differ from fal during the accepted transition. Published rates: [text-to-video](https://fal.ai/models/minimax/h3-max-turbo/text-to-video), [image-to-video](https://fal.ai/models/minimax/h3-max-turbo/image-to-video).


- September 30 refresh: merged current `main` and resolved pricing conflicts. 134 Gen handler/tracking tests and 68 Enter pricing tests pass; Gen/Enter typechecks, Biome, and diff checks pass.

gist.headline: Turbo rates find their footing
gist.blurb: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo is back on its published post-promotion rates. Three resolutions, two video routes, and one less pricing mystery.
gist.summary: Restored MiniMax H3 Max Turbo cost and customer prices for text-to-video and image-to-video to fal’s post-promotion rates: $0.025/s at 480p, $0.04/s at 768p, and $0.08/s at 1080p, with priceMultiplier kept at 1.
gist.impact: A five-second MiniMax H3 Max Turbo video is priced at $0.125, $0.20, or $0.40 for 480p, 768p, or 1080p respectively on either route.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MiniMax H3 Max Turbo as a cozy video-editing desk with three small film frames labeled 480p, 768p, and 1080p, representing the restored resolution-specific rates. Polli checks matching price tags beside two film reels for text-to-video and image-to-video; use no invented MiniMax or fal mascot.
